SDHI | FROM THE CEO’S DESK
"The first half of FY27 marks SDHI’s transition from turnaround to scaled execution. Having completed our resolution
plan and settled our obligations to the Committee of Creditors, we have focused on building the systems, processes
and teams needed to deliver our order book. Winning export orders again in H1 FY27 reflects the growing confidence
of international customers in SDHIand in India as a credible shipbuilding partner.
Our priority now is to deliver on time and to global quality standards. At the same time, we expect domestic
shipbuilding demand to pick up over the next 12 to 18 months, driven by the Government of India’s push to expand
commercial shipbuilding and by proposed defence programmes. SDHI is well placed to win at home and abroad, and to
turn that into sustained growth forourshareholders."
- Rear Admiral Vipin KumarSaxena(Retd.), ChiefExecutiveOfficer, SwanDefenceandHeavyIndustriesLimited
